pages.title: Protected Chemistry
pages.text: Prepared protection makes toxic processing more manageable.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Polymer supplies acid/radiation protection, not guaranteed immunity. Flowing acid rusts scrap; Acidic Radrock above sulfur stacks supports growth, and a bottle captures vent gas.

pages.title: Field notes
pages.text: Brainiacs use drums for healing and acid attacks; their remnants support nuclear machinery. Gammaroaches target irradiated creatures and can fetch stronger threats. Soylent Green heals under Irradiated.
